sections.label: Constitutional Commission Elected Presidency review
sections.summary: The Constitutional Commission reviewing aspects of the Elected Presidency concluded its study, drawing on 25 years of the institution.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Speaker
sentences.text: Pursuant to Standing Order 16(1), I will now read the message to hon Members. "Hon Members, the Constitutional Commission tasked to review specific aspects of the Elected Presidency recently concluded its study.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Speaker
sentences.text: It was a landmark review drawing on 25 years of operating an important and unique institution in Singapore.

sections.label: Reserved Presidential election ethnic mechanism
sections.summary: The Government accepted the Commission's recommendation to reserve a Presidential election for an ethnic group absent from the office after five terms.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Speaker
sentences.text: The Government has accepted the Commission's recommendation for a mechanism of reserving a Presidential election for a specific ethnic group if a member of that group has not held the office of the Elected Presidency after five terms.

sections.label: Elected President custodial functions
sections.summary: The Elected President has custodial functions over the national Reserves and the integrity of public servants.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Speaker
sentences.text: Another key role of the Elected President today is his custodial functions over two key assets built up by generations of Singaporeans – our national Reserves and the integrity of our public servants.

sections.label: Eligibility criteria enhancement data cited
sections.summary: The Commission cited data, including GDP growth and official foreign Reserves size since 1991, in recommending enhanced eligibility criteria for candidates.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Speaker
sentences.text: In recommending the enhancement of eligibility criteria for Presidential candidates, the Commission has cited many pieces of data, including the growth of Singapore's gross domestic product (GDP) and size of official foreign Reserves since 1991.

sections.label: Elected Presidency not second power centre
sections.summary: The Elected Presidency cannot be a second centre of power.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Speaker
sentences.text: The Elected Presidency cannot be a second centre of power.

sections.label: Gridlock scenarios and effective custodian
sections.summary: Removing all possible gridlock scenarios is not practical while expecting the Elected President to remain an effective custodian.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Speaker
sentences.text: Nevertheless, while the President should not be unbridled in the exercise of his Constitutional duties, it is not practical to remove all possible scenarios of gridlock and yet expect the Elected President to remain an effective custodian.

sections.label: Elected Presidency proposed changes
sections.summary: The Elected Presidency was an adjustment, and Members are encouraged to consider proposed changes to it for the next half century and beyond.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Speaker
sentences.text: The institution of the Elected Presidency was one such adjustment.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Speaker
sentences.text: I encourage all Members of this House to consider the current proposed changes to it with an eye on the next half century and beyond."
